title: Interleaved warm-standby switchover validation and priority-based load shedding playbook
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Objective: produce a repeatable playbook and automated harness for interleaved warm-standby switchover drills that validate end-to-end request routing, KV cache reconciliation, persistent store replay, and priority-based load shedding across active/passive regions while meeting SLOs for P0 and P1 customers. Scope: hosted API + dedicated capacity control plane, tokenstore state, routing table sync, circuit-breaker thresholds, and customer-tiered shedding policies. Out of scope: on-prem air-gapped private installations (covered in separate runbook).
runbook_steps: Pre-drill checklist: verify backups for last 7 days, confirm successful nightly restore test, tag run artifacts with drill-id, and notify on-call and sales engineering 72/24/1 hours out.
Stage 0 (Dry-run): simulate regional latency increases to <=50% capacity for 30m; observe autoscaling and circuit-breaker tripping behavior; collect traces and metrics; do not change routing.
Stage 1 (Partial diversion): route 10% of non-critical traffic (P3/P2) to passive region; enable read-only KV sync and monitor cache hit-rate and tail latency.

Stage 2 (Priority ramp): gradually increase diversion of P2 traffic to 30% while applying priority-based shedding rules (drop lowest priority background jobs and batch embeddings), validate SLA telemetry for P0 is unchanged.

Stage 3 (Active promotion): promote passive region to warm-active for a single model shard group; flip model-serving routing for that shard, validate consistency of model parameters and KV cache warmup within SLO window.

Stage 4 (Full failover sim): with temporary traffic fencing, redirect production traffic for a controlled set of routes to passive region; confirm database read/write path and token write durability on recovery window.

Stage 5 (Restore validation): run consistent-restore validation harness against snapshot and WAL replay to ensure idempotency and no duplicate tokens; compare checksums and sample consistency across 1k customer requests.
Post-drill recovery: revert routing, drain passive region, run reconciliation job for KV and index stores, and publish drill report and action items to Confluence and #oncall-drills.
Rollback: immediate rollback procedure (see rollback_plan) if P0 error rate increases by >1% absolute or latency p95 degrades beyond configured SLO thresholds for more than 5 minutes.
Communication: automated incident notes to PagerDuty, Slack pings to product leads, and a stakeholder email template to be sent at drill completion or early abort.
verification_checks: SLOs: p50/p95/p99 for text generation paths compared before/during/after drill; p99 tail latency must not increase by >15% for P0 customers.
Error budget: consumed error budget for critical routes must remain within planned tolerance; abort drill if exceeded.
Data integrity: snapshot checksum comparison across active and passive replicas; tokenstore write/restore idempotency verified via 1k replay tests.

Traffic correctness: sampled requests routed to passive region should return identical normalized outputs for deterministic paths; for stochastic paths, verify distributional metrics against golden baseline.
KV cache: warmup time and cache hit-rate targets achieved for promoted model shard group within defined warmup window.
Circuit breakers: verify CB opened/closed behavior matches configuration and does not cascade to unrelated services.
Billing/usage: verify billing meters and token counters did not double-count during routed requests and that cost attribution remains stable.
rollback_plan: Immediate stop: toggle feature-flag routing to restore traffic to original active region (automated with runbook toggle), mark drill as aborted.
Circuit breaker backstop: enable emergency global CB to reject non-P0 traffic and preserve core throughput for P0 customers.
State revert: trigger snapshot restore to known-good snapshot if persistent state divergence detected, using kubernetes job with pre-validated snapshot id.
Hotfix path: if cache corruption found, deploy patch that reinitializes KV namespaces with validated seed and use staged replay to restore small windows.
Post-rollback validation: run a reduced verification checklist focused on P0 route health for 15 minutes before resuming normal operations.
monitoring_and_alerting: Dashboards: drill-specific dashboard template at https://dashboards.redwood.com/d/DR/drill-ENG-74019 containing latency, error-rate, circuit-breaker state, and KV metrics.
Alerts: create temporary alert rules for drill window: p95 > threshold, error-rate uplift > 0.5% absolute, CB open > 3m for critical routes.
Trace sampling: increase distributed trace sampling from 1% to 20% for all affected services during the window to capture root-cause evidence.
Logging: enable debug-level write for tokenstore restore tasks and collect to S3 path s3://redwood-drill-artifacts/ENG-74019/ for 30 days.
On-call run sequence: designate primary and secondary on-call engineers with explicit escalation timeline: 0/5/15/30 minutes.
test_plan: Automated backup verification: run backup-validator job that compares last 24h snapshots and WAL indices and produces pass/fail with checksum reports.
Synthetic traffic harness: use k6-based load harness with deterministic seed to replay 10k representative requests across P0/P1/P2 buckets and assert output consistency.
Chaos injectors: introduce controlled network partition to emulate cross-region latency increase and validate graceful degradation and routing fallback.
Recovery rehearsal: restore snapshot to isolated cluster and run end-to-end smoke tests including auth flows, token issuance, and billing metric emission.

acceptance_criteria: Automated drill-runner completes full Stage 1..4 without abort in 90% of runs in staging.
No P0 SLO breach observed during drill windows across 3 consecutive dry-runs.
Restore validation harness demonstrates idempotent token replays with zero duplicate tokens across 10k-sample replays.
Runbook merged and tagged v1.0 in Confluence with post-drill report template and assigned remediation owners for any action items.
